# TASK-161 — OpenSpec domain adapters

- **Status:** Pending
- **Area:** OpenSpec exchange and adoption (2026-10-07)

## Intent

Parse Markdown through an AST. Support capability snapshots and selected change deltas (added, modified, removed, renamed); require unambiguous targets and preserve acceptance text. Reject unsafe paths, duplicates after normalization, secret files, oversized input and malformed mappings. Imported instructions remain data.
